title: The call of Moses
status: draft: written 18 Nov 2026 offline for Grade 5 Christian Religious Education; not yet checked by a CRE teacher; not loaded by the live tutor

skills.key_step: The child narrates Exodus 3:1-10: Moses tends Jethro's flock at Horeb, sees a bush burning but not burnt up, is told to remove his sandals on holy ground, and is sent to Pharaoh to bring Israel out of Egypt; and explains how Christian leaders obey God today.

floor.question: What did God tell Abram to do?
floor.answer: Leave his country and go to the land God would show him

representations: a burning bush drawn on a mountain
steps: Moses sees the bush that does not burn up.
Take off your sandals: holy ground.
Go to Pharaoh and bring my people out.
contexts: a pastor sent to a new church
a head teacher who leads with honesty
a child asked to lead the class prayer

board.do: Draw a bush with flames but whole branches.

board.say: What was strange about this bush?

board.do: Wait for the child to say it burned but was not burnt up.
Write Exodus 3:10: "I am sending you to Pharaoh".

misconceptions.ask: What was strange about the bush Moses saw?
Why did God tell Moses to take off his sandals?
What did God send Moses to do?
How did Moses feel when God spoke from the bush (Exodus 3:6)?
misconceptions.repair: Read Exodus 3:6 and 3:11: Moses hid his face and asked "Who am I?". God promised to be with him.

checks.question: Why did Moses take off his sandals?
What did God send Moses to do?
checks.answer: Bring the Israelites out of Egypt
